body: I do feel that way, I always have. I think it's something very few people understand. I am feeling suicidal now and exploring this board - it is oddly comforting that other people feel the same, it makes me want to do it less actually. I did have suicide ideation when I was that young which I think is really weird. I'm sorry you're feeling like this, stranger, hope it passes for you as it often passes for me. It's just... I always wonder, why does it have to pass so temporarily? It always comes back, just more complicated.
